Q5910.reason: A recorded general-plan ban on building that binds later takers with notice is an equitable servitude.

Q5623.reason: The commentary is opinion about a public figure's public protest, so the public-interest privilege defeats an invasion-of-privacy claim.

Q5004.reason: The executory interest can vest on a remote church use, or when a child turns 25 more than 21 years after the sister's death, so it is void and the friend holds the fee.
